exposure: Fetal position at delivery (occiput anterior (OA) vs. occiput posterior (OP))
cohort: Women without a previous cesarean section and a live singleton fetus in cephalic presentation at term
finding: Implementation of active perineal support and lateral episiotomy was associated with a long-lasting reduction in OASIS rates.
mod_finding: Lateral episiotomy was associated with lower OASIS rates in nulliparous women with instrumental deliveries, particularly in those with OA or OP fetal positions.
